topicName: Best Practices for Element Selection (data-cy, data-testid)
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Best Practices for Element Selection in Cypress"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Choosing the right selectors in Cypress is crucial for writing robust and maintainable end-to-end tests. Fragile selectors like CSS classes or IDs often lead to flaky tests when the UI changes."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Why Avoid CSS Classes and IDs?"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Using volatile selectors such as .btn-primary-lg or #submit-btn-123 is a bad practice. Styling changes or refactoring can easily alter these attributes, causing your tests to fail even when the functionality remains intact."},{"order":5,"type":"subheading","text":"Using data-cy and data-testid Attributes"},{"order":6,"type":"paragraph","text":"The industry standard for robust testing is to use dedicated attributes specifically for automation, such as data-cy, data-testid, or data-qa. These attributes decouple your tests from styling and structural changes."},{"order":7,"type":"code","text":"<button data-cy=\"submit-button\">Submit</button>"},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Configuring Custom Selectors in Cypress"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"By default, Cypress uses cy.get() with standard CSS selectors. You can streamline your tests by utilizing cy.get('[data-cy=...]') or by creating custom commands to make selection cleaner."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"Cypress.Commands.add('getByDataCy', (value) => {\n  return cy.get(`[data-cy=\"${value}\"]`);\n});"},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Summary of Selection Rules"},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Never target elements by CSS classes that are used for styling."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Avoid using deep CSS descendent selectors that break with minor HTML refactoring."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use data-cy or data-testid attributes for mission-critical elements."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Keep selector names descriptive and aligned with user actions or component intent."}]
